comment: Template for $DAPILOT_STORE_DIR/reference/etsy-listing.json: shop-wide choices every Etsy listing gets. scripts/dev/shop.sh setup writes it after the Etsy sign-in, filling the ids when the shop has exactly one of each; otherwise list them with etsy_listing.py profiles and fill them in. Activating a physical listing needs shipping_profile_id, return_policy_id and readiness_state_id.
